KEY TAKEAWAYS

  • Amazon’s biggest sale of the year, Black Friday, runs Tuesday, November 17 to Monday, November 30
  • The sale sees thousands of home and tech deals up to 78% off
  • Top deals include the ECOVACS DEEBOT T80 Omni Robot Vacuum for 78% off, from $2,299 to $449, the Ninja SLUSHi for 67% off, from $599.99 to $195, and the Amazon Kindle Paperwhite for 38% off, from $369 to $227

While the Amazon Prime Day and Big Deal Days sales are behind us, Amazon has saved its biggest sale of the year for last. Black Friday kicked off on Tuesday, November 17 and runs right through to Cyber Monday on November 30, giving you 14 days of deal mayhem.

You’ll find big discounts on crowd-favourite brands like Ninja, Dyson, Kindle and KitchenAid. But Amazon’s huge sale section can be a lot to wade through, and it’s hard to tell the real bargains from the impulse buys.

Did you know: you can shop the BHG team’s top Amazon picks straight from our very own storefront!

So we’ve done the legwork for you. Whether you’re after a robot vacuum, a new kitchen appliance or an e-reader so you can save money on books, we’ve rounded up the best deals to help your budget go further before prices go back up.

Explore the best deals from this year’s Amazon Big Deal Days sale

While Amazon Black Friday sales span all kinds of product categories, there are a few worth paying closer attention to during the huge sale event.

According to our historical coverage, kitchen appliances, tech, heaters, cleaning appliances, cookware, and home gym items often see the biggest discounts.

Shop BHG’s top Big Deal Days bargains, at a glance:

  1. Kitchen appliances
  2. Smart home tech & electronics
  3. Electric heaters
  4. Vacuums, spot cleaners, & mops
  5. Home gym equipment

To make it even easier, we’ve rounded up our top picks from each; no more combing through countless pages of sale items!

3 golden rules for smart Amazon Black Friday sale shopping

No matter which sales event you choose, follow these three rules to ensure you are genuinely getting a bargain:

  1. Use price tracking tools: Don’t just trust a “was/is” price tag. Use free price-tracking sites to see the exact price history of an item over the last 12 months.
  2. Factor in delivery costs: A massive discount on a large item can quickly be wiped out by a $150 delivery fee. Amazon usually offers relatively cheap delivery fees, but check the fine print before checking out and consider signing up to become a Prime member for potential free shipping.
  3. Tick off your holiday gifting: Amazon Black Friday is a great opportunity to start your holiday shopping before you have to battle the end-of-year rush.

Frequently asked questions: Amazon Black Friday sale

When is Amazon’s next sale?

Amazon Australia’s Black Friday sale kicked off on Tuesday, November 17 and runs until Cyber Monday on November 30, 2026.

What is the Amazon Black Friday sale?

Black Friday is Amazon’s biggest sale event of the year, with up to 78% off. Like Prime Day, it’s a chance for shoppers to save big on a range of cult-favourite brands, including Ninja, KitchenAid and ECOVACS.

Do you have to have an Amazon Prime membership to shop the Black Friday sale?

No, you don’t have to be an Amazon Prime member to access the discounts offered during the Black Friday sale, but you do need to be a member for free shipping. Membership costs $12.99 per month, or you can sign up for a free 30-day trial and cancel it when you’re done shopping.

Shopping Editor Paris Blanchfield Shopping Editor

Paris Blanchfield is the shopping editor for Are Media’s homes and lifestyle vertical, where she navigates the overlap of design, lifestyle, and culture with a discerning eye and more active browser tabs than she’s willing to admit. Armed with over eight years of experience in writing and editorial (and an art history degree that she insists is less pretentious than it sounds), Paris approaches interiors with an editor’s precision and a critic’s eye, always looking for ways to pair aesthetics with functionality. Since launching her career in Aotearoa’s media scene, her bylines have appeared in the likes of Remix, Black Magazine, Sauce and Ensemble, where she developed a reputation for her astute and aesthetically informed insights. Now based in Sydney, her focus lies in helping readers cultivate dreamy living spaces and daily rituals through mindful shopping.

Manage your data

Purposes

Store and/or access information on a device

Cookies, device or similar online identifiers (e.g. login-based identifiers, randomly assigned identifiers, network based identifiers) together with other information (e.g. browser type and information, language, screen size, supported technologies etc.) can be stored or read on your device to recognise it each time it connects to an app or to a website, for one or several of the purposes presented here.

View details

Create profiles for personalised advertising

Measure advertising performance

Measure content performance

For instance, whether you read an article, watch a video, listen to a podcast or look at a product description, how long you spent on this service and the web pages you visit etc. This is very helpful to understand the relevance of (non-advertising) content that is shown to you.

Storage, duration, and usage details

The choices you make with this CMP regarding the purposes and entities will affect how personalized advertising is presented to you. We need to store these choices to respect them on future visits, and they are stored differently based on the type of site or app you're using:
  • For sites, your choices are saved in a cookie named “FCCDCF” for a maximum duration of 390 days.
  • For apps, your choices are saved in device storage prefixed by “IABTCF_”. Your choices will be invalidated after 390 days and overwritten once you make new privacy choices on this app.
  • For accelerated mobile page (AMP) sites, your choices are saved in local storage prefixed by “amp-store”. Your choices will be invalidated after 390 days and overwritten once you make new privacy choices on this site.
